result.summary: Found 1 issue: a restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of food photography. Horizontally clipped carousel items and bottom-viewport cutoff were excluded as instructed.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' displays a gray broken-image placeholder icon (generic mountain/image symbol) instead of an actual restaurant/dish photo, while the '€0 delivery' badge and favorite heart still render on top of the empty image area.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/asset loading for this restaurant, add a retry/fallback, and use a branded or neutral placeholder (or hide the card) rather than the system broken-image icon.
